settings.apiTokensHelp: Personal access tokens let you authenticate with the API without a browser session.
settings.auditLogHelp: Security-relevant actions from the last 7 days. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.
settings.displayNameHelp: Shown instead of your mail address throughout the app.
settings.displayNamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use your mail address
settings.languageHelp: Language of the web interface. "Automatic" follows your browser's language.
settings.tokenCreatedHelp: Copy it now. You won't see it again.
settings.totpDisableHelp: Disabling the second factor leaves your account protected by the password alone.
settings.totpDisableHouseholdWarning: Your household requires two-factor authentication. You will be asked to set it up again at the next sign-in.
settings.totpEnrolHelp: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows to finish.
settings.totpQrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
settings.totpRecoveryHelp: These codes are shown only once. Store them somewhere safe — each one signs you in a single time if you lose your authenticator.
settings.totpStatusOffHelp: Add a second factor so a leaked password alone does not open your household.
settings.totpStatusOnHelp: Your account asks for a code from your authenticator app at sign-in. %d recovery codes are left.
settings.totpStatusRequiredHelp: Your household requires two-factor authentication. Set up an authenticator app to sign in.
settings.usernameHelp: Login credential — cannot be changed here.
